properties.title: Text Colour

ai.name: textColour
ai.description: How the preset picks its text colours. From Theme uses the theme's own colour ramp. Flipped uses the opposite end of that ramp, for a theme whose ramp runs the other way round and leaves the text unreadable. Fixed uses literal colours that ignore the theme entirely.

properties.info: Can't read the text? Some themes set their colour ramps the other way round, with the light shades where the dark ones normally are, and a card built on that theme can come out white on white. Flipped takes the opposite end of the same ramp, so the cards still re-skin when you switch theme - it applies to Card and Minimal, which take their text and their background from different parts of the theme and so can come apart. Bold and Contrast take both from the same part, which means they move together and already correct themselves, so Flipped deliberately leaves those two alone. Fixed uses literal colours that ignore the theme: it always reads, on any preset, but it no longer follows the theme. From Theme is what every existing instance already uses and nothing about it has changed.
